text: **Stage question:** resolve dimensions, alignment, overflow and critical edge cases from approved Mid-Fidelity. Proposed geometry, not brand tokens. Validate 320 / 390 / 768 / 1024 / 1280 widths; sidebar 272, rail 64, drawer 304 (clamp for small phones); content max 740, desktop inset 40 / mobile 20; minimum 44 target intent; no horizontal scrolling. Keep all 21 lifecycle states in the approved inventory. Use component studies for action sizing, error copy, pagination, wrapping and focus; prototype validates real keyboard/touch, announcements and reflow.
